themes.title: Far-right push for 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying their advocacy for 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in access to welfare, housing, and public services. This theme has gained traction in Spain, Italy, France, and Poland, with parties like Vox, Fratelli d'Italia, Rassemblement National, and Prawo i Sprawiedliwość framing these policies as essential for preserving national identity and resources.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Proposes motions in local councils to enforce 'national priority' in welfare and housing, criticizing current migration policies as ineffective.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Advocates for policies that prioritize Italian citizens in public services, aligning with broader nationalist rhetoric.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Promotes 'national priority' in welfare and public services, framing it as a response to immigration and EU overreach.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Supports policies that prioritize Polish citizens in healthcare and social benefits, often linking them to national sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticizes immigration policies and advocates for stricter controls, aligning with 'national priority' rhetoric.

themes.title: Trump-Meloni diplomatic fallout escalates
themes.blurb: The diplomatic rift between U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has intensified, with public exchanges over Italy's refusal to support U.S. military actions against Iran and Meloni's alleged pursuit of a photo opportunity at the G7 summit. This theme reflects broader tensions between nationalist leaders and their international alliances, with implications for NATO and EU-U.S. relations.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump

countries.note: Monitors the fallout, with some figures expressing solidarity with Meloni's stance.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes Meloni's handling of the dispute, framing it as a failure of leadership.

themes.title: Internal divisions within far-right parties
themes.blurb: Far-right parties in Europe and Latin America are grappling with internal divisions, ranging from leadership struggles to ideological disputes. These divisions are evident in parties like Fratelli d'Italia, Alternative für Deutschland, La Libertad Avanza, and Fidesz, where factions compete for influence and control over policy direction.
